12.name: Abbott and Costello Meet the Killer, Boris Karloff
12.overview: Two employees of a secluded hotel investigate a murder on the premises in which the goofy bellboy is the prime suspect.

12.name: The Brides of Dracula
12.overview: A young teacher on her way to a position in Transylvania helps a young man escape the shackles his mother has put on him. In so doing she innocently unleashes the horrors of the undead once again on the populace, including those at her school for ladies. Luckily for some, Dr Van Helsing is already on his way.

12.name: The Raven
12.overview: A brilliant surgeon with a morbid obsession for instruments of torture grows dangerously obsessed with a young socialite whose life he's saved.

13.name: House of Frankenstein
13.overview: After escaping from the asylum, the deranged Dr. Niemann and his loyal hunchback assistant, Daniel, revive not only the evil Count Dracula, but the Wolf Man and Frankenstein's monster as well. All in order to exact revenge upon their many enemies.

13.name: The Raven (1935)
13.overview:
A brilliant surgeon with a morbid obsession for instruments of torture grows dangerously obsessed with a young socialite whose life he's saved.

14.name: The Invisible Man (1933)
14.overview: A scientist finds a way of becoming invisible, but in doing so, he becomes murderously insane.

14.name: The Invisible Man Returns
14.overview: The owner of a coal mining operation, falsely imprisoned for fratricide, takes a drug to make him invisible, despite its side effect: gradual madness.

15.name: The Thing with Two Heads
15.overview: Doctors are forced to transplant the head of terminally ill, arthritic surgeon Maxwell Kirshner onto the body of African American Death Row inmate Jack Moss because there is no other donor.

19.name: King Kong Escapes
19.overview: The evil Dr. Who captures King Kong to dig for Element X when his robot duplicate, Mechani-Kong, is unable to do the job, but Kong soon escapes and battles his doppelganger.

20.name: The Thing that Couldn't Die
20.overview: A psychically gifted young woman discovers a centuries-old crate buried on her aunt's ranch. Opening it, her family discovers the living head of Gideon Drew, a 16th century devil worshiper who was beheaded by Sir Francis Drake.

21.name: Invisible Agent
21.overview: The Invisible Man's grandson uses his secret formula to spy on Nazi Germany.

22.name: Invisible Agent
22.overview: The Invisible Man's grandson uses his secret formula to spy on Nazi Germany in this comedy-thriller.

23.name: It Came From Outer Space
23.overview: Svengoolie presents 'It Came From Outer Space'. A spaceship from another world crashes in the Arizona desert and only an amateur stargazer and a schoolteacher suspect alien influence when the local townsfolk begin to act strangely.

24.name: The Mad Magician
24.overview: An illusionist becomes homicidal when his best kept magic secrets are stolen by his rival.

24.name: The Blob
24.overview: A deadly entity from space crash-lands near a small town and begins consuming everyone in its path. Panic ensues as shady government scientists try to contain the horrific creature.

24.name: The Return of the Vampire (1943)
24.overview: In 1918, an English family are terrorized by a vampire, until they learn how to deal with it. They think their troubles are over, but German bombs in WWII free the monster. He reclaims the soul of his wolfman ex-servant, and assuming the identity of a scientist who has just escaped from a concentration camp, he starts out on a plan to get revenge upon the family.

32.name: Blood from the Mummy's Tomb (1971)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV-we begin 2026 in a situation connected to reincarnation- in which the spirit of a powerful Egyptian queen attempts to transfer her malevolence to a contemporary young woman and return to rule again- in the 1971 Hammer horror “Blood From The Mummy’s Tomb”!

32.name: The Skull (1965)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we face a cranial catastrophe when a scholar and collector of supernatural artifacts obtains one that has unexpected power – which influences him to do dark deeds! Peter Cushing is the unlucky man who is plagued by “The Skull”!

32.name: Flight 7500 (2014)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- our favorite man in the hat is letting us, the Sven Squad – Gwengoolie, Nostalgiaferatoo and IMP aka Ignatius Malvolio Prankenstein - take over hosting duties for the evening. Sven will be here, but we’re steering this ship, or more accurately for tonight, flying this plane! We’d like to welcome you aboard House of Svengoolie’s “Flight 7500” with service from Los Angeles to Tokyo. (House of Svengoolie)

32.name: King Kong vs Godzilla (1962)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- it wouldn’t be wise to place any bets on the outcome of this giant faceoff (especially since the outcome was available many years ago)- but you can bet on this: the old-school giant monster matchup from 1963-when two of the biggest monsters in horror history collided in an epic battle of building-flattening fury-is a real winner! See Japan's greatest horror export face off against the legendary giant ape who first thrilled America (in slightly different form!) in 1933-it's "King Kong VS Godzilla"!

32.name: War of the Colossal Beast (1958)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we give you a change of pace from the icy weather that has gripped a major portion of our nation- by heading to another warmer nation in which an enormous menace, thought to have expired, has re-appeared! Once it is realized that this bizarre creature has become even more dangerous than it was previously, two adjoining countries come together as allies to engage in the “War of the Colossal Beast”!

32.name: The Gorgon (1964)
32.overview: Yeah, yeah, I know the phrase is “statute”, but you’ll get the idea if you tune in to MeTV tonight- when Hammer studio’s top stars- Peter Cushing AND Christopher Lee must battle a mythological monster lurking in early 20th century Prussia- turning its victims to stone- as petrified victims of ‘The Gorgon”!

32.name: Dracula (1931)
32.overview: Tonight, on MeTV- as our valentine to you-we again double down on our horror entertainment- first, celebrating the 95th anniversary of a true cornerstone of Universal horror’s legacy-the movie that established Bela Lugosi in most people’s minds as the embodiment of Bram Stoker’s vampire count!

32.name: Dinoshark (2010)
32.overview: Then, the Sven Squad has more late Roger Corman mayhem with the prehistoric combo platter of “DinoShark”!

32.name: The Mist (2007)
32.overview: Tonight, on MeTV- The Sven Squad – Gwengoolie, Nostalgiaferatoo and IMP aka Ignatius Malvolio Prankenstein – are premiering the 2007 Frank Darabont directed thriller “The Mist” on House of Svengoolie. Get ready to feel your way through 2 and a half hours of terror which you both can’t see coming and then wish you hadn’t seen once you do.

32.name: The War of the Worlds (1953)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we are happy to bring you a movie we have been trying to get for quite a while- a classic science fiction film of the early 50s, based on an iconic tale by H.G. Wells. It pits humanity against a frightening invasion from the red planet-depicted with amazing special effects for the era. Get ready to take up arms for the “The War of the Worlds”!

32.name: Son of Frankenstein (1939)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- it’s the film in Universal’s Frankenstein series that established a significant new character in the canon- presented the final appearance by a great actor in a role that made him a legend- and held the basis for some future fun in “Young Frankenstein”- as Boris Karloff, Bela Lugosi, and Basil Rathbone pick up where Henry Frankesntein left off in the 1939 classic- “Son of Frankenstein”!

32.name: Friday the 13th (1980)
32.overview: Actually, today is Saturday, the 14th, but tonight, on MeTV - The Sven Squad – Gwengoolie, Nostalgiaferatoo and IMP aka Ignatius Malvolio Prankenstein – are premiering 1980’s OG “Friday The 13th” on House of Svengoolie. So pack a bag for Camp Crystal Lake with the granddaddy of all the teen killer sleepaway camp movies.

32.name: The Mummy's Hand (1940)
32.overview: It’s time for some March mummy madness tonight on MeTV-as we unwrap the first sequel to the original Karloff "Mummy"- in which a couple down-on-their luck archeologists stumble upon a clue to the whereabouts of the tomb of ancient Egyptian Princess of Ananka- not realizing that it is protected by an evil high priest and the living mummy who loved the Princess in her lifetime! Danger and death will be dealt to all infidels by “The Mummy’s Hand”!

32.name: House on Haunted Hill (1959)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we wind up our macabre March with a real favorite- centered on a mysterious mansion that contains a gaggle of ghosts- some domestic tension between the couple in residence- and a group of needy subjects who are given the chance to gain wealth- IF they can avoid losing their lives! It’s the original 1959 William Castle version of “House on Haunted Hill”-starring Vincent Price!

32.name: An American Werewolf in London (1981)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- it’s an iconic 1981 horror movie from director John Landis-featuring groundbreaking make-up and special effects by Rick Baker that won him an Oscar- in the story of two young men who end up out on the moors- and have an encounter with a werewolf that leaves one of them ready to assume the title of “An American Werewolf in London”!

32.name: The Car (1977)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- buckle up for a ride with a violent vehicle that gives citizens of a small desert town a hellish hit-and-run -it’s the deadly and devilish driverless destruction of- "The Car"!

32.name: Parents (1989)
32.overview: April showers bring … cannibalistic parents living in the 1950s California suburbs with their only son? Yes, you read that right! Spring is in the air and tonight, on MeTV - The Sven Squad – are premiering 1989’s “Parents” on House of Svengoolie.

32.name: How to Make a Monster (1958)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV-for those who have been missing good old 1950s American International monster mayhem-we’re bringing back a film that gave an encore to the studio’s Teenage Frankenstein and Teenage Werewolf! Our viewers always request another look at how a master of creature creations decides to strike back at the heartless studio heads who have decided to show him the door- by bringing his monsters back, but with a twist-this time, it isn’t fear film fantasy- it’s for real, as he demonstrates “How to Make a Monster”!

32.name: Frankenstein and the Monster from Hell (1974)
32.overview: It’s a film that marked the end of an era- actually, two eras- tonight on MeTV when we present what was not only the last film in Hammer’s original Frankenstein series- but also the final time that the great Peter Cushing played Baron Frankenstein! A young doctor who idolizes the work of the original “body-builder” (you know what I mean) finds himself joining forces with the Baron to conduct new experiments in an asylum-where it sometimes seems like the inmates are running things. There are many challenges to one’s sanity when you encounter “Frankenstein and the Monster from Hell”!

32.name: First Men in the Moon (1964)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- after viewing the excitement of a real-life moon mission just last month- we launch an H.G. Wells tale of another journey to the moon- a previously unknown event that occurred years before the advent of NASA! We flashback to the late 1800s to learn the truth about the original lunar landing of the “First Men in The Moon”!

32.name: Rosemary's Baby (1968)
32.overview: It’s May! Spring is in full bloom … and a bunch of people in New York living in The Dakota but calling it “The Bramford” are preparing to welcome Satan’s son into the world. Terrifying, right?! Tonight, on MeTV - The Sven Squad – Gwengoolie, Nostalgiaferatoo and IMP aka Ignatius Malvolio Prankenstein – are premiering 1968’s “Rosemary’s Baby” on House of Svengoolie. Instead of May flowers, you’ll be smelling something a little more fire and brimstone.

32.name: Dr. Cyclops (1940)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we bring back a Technicolor favorite with ground-breaking special effects for the time it was produced-as members of a scientific expedition are honored to be summoned to assist a legendary scientist- only to become victims of a process he has invented that makes them shrink! They must survive the near-sighted nastiness of the enemy they call- "Dr. Cyclops"!

32.name: Earth vs. The Spider (1958)
32.overview: Tonight, on MeTV- if you are confused and thought THIS weekend should be Memorial Day weekend, don’t worry- you may have missed your first chance of grilling last weekend, but this weekend we’ll provide you with the webber (yes, lame stretch joke playing off the Weber grill). We’re bringing back another massive monster provided by Bert I. Gordon (notice his initials)- in his 1958 feature which has a small town endangered by a big (yes, like the initials) arachnid! Local teens try to warn the authorities that a deadly battle is eminent- that main event being “Earth VS the Spider”!

32.name: Curse of the Demon (1957)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV, we bring you to England with a skeptical psychologist who plans to debunk reports of a Satanic cult using supernatural powers to destroy their enemies. His skepticism disappears when he finds more than he bargained for- and becomes the target of the “Curse of the Demon”!

32.name: Idle Hands (1999)
32.overview: Summertime … and the living’s easy. But the dying is even easier! Average American teenager Anton seems to have it all: 2 loving parents, 2 best friends and his crush Molly living right across the street. But he wakes up on Halloween morning with one small problem: a whole lot of people around him are dead or dying. Fast. And gruesomely. And Anton is increasingly losing control of his own right hand. Throw in a druidic high priestess, some local cops, his monster-truck driving neighbor Randy and more late-90s cameos than Being John Malkovich. Tonight, on MeTV - The Sven Squad along with The Man In The Hat himself – Svengoolie – are premiering 1999’s “Idle Hands” on House of Svengoolie.

32.name: The Time of Their Lives (1946)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we bring back a hilarious haunting that many viewers have been requesting for quite a while- an Abbott and Costello vehicle, but NOT the one with Frankenstein! It’s also unique, with the boys not as a pair, but in separate roles. It all begins during the Revolutionary War and ends with ghosts plaguing a mansion in modern day (if your modern day is 1946) in an attempt to free their spirits from this earthly realm. This ghost story sets Lou Costello, as one of the earthbound spirits, against an ancestor of a colonial rat (both played by Bud Abbott) who's partially responsible for his fate- guaranteeing both the “Time of Their Lives”!

32.name: Destroy All Monsters (1968)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- an alien race has taken control of the biggest and baddest Kaiju creatures that ever came from the Toho Studios! Earth thought they had them safely under control- but the alien takeover gives them no choice but to- “Destroy All Monsters”!

32.name: Invisible Agent (1942)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- before the rockets’ red glare of the traditional fireworks shows- we have a title character who serves the nation without needing fame- or-uh- clothes! You've heard of untold stories of World War II- tonight, we have an unSEEN story- with its major player unseen- as we meet yet another member of the Griffin family who opts for transparency- this time, in the defense of his country-as the “Invisible Agent”!

32.name: Village of the Giants (1965)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- it’s a super-sized summer sensation -as we bring back a sort of “beach party” movie- minus the beach- featuring some MeTV actors, a favorite singer pal of ours, some colossal cuties and super-sized studs- in a crazy sci fi dramedy from the mind of Bert I. Gordon, king of oversized menace movies! It all begins when a familiar–looking boy genius cooks up a formula transferring a small town into BIG trouble by converting it into the “Village of the Giants”!

32.name: Swamp Thing (1982)
32.overview: Swamp Thing … you make Adrienne Barbeau’s heart sing! Dr. Alec Holland is just your run of the mill scientist working on bio-engineering a new animal plant hybrid in his lab which happens to be set up in a swamp. Alice Cable is the government worker, new to the swamp to replace the mysteriously disappeared previous scientist. Dr. Holland accidentally spills an experimental formula on himself and turns into a half man/half plant named… Swamp Thing! An opportunist named Arcane wants the formula and will stop at nothing to get it. Swamp Thing will do anything to protect the swamp and the lovely Alice Cable. Tonight, on MeTV - The Sven Squad – Gwengoolie, Nostalgiaferatoo and IMP aka Ignatius Malvolio Prankenstein along with The Man In The Hat himself – Svengoolie – are premiering 1982’s “Swamp Thing” on House of Svengoolie.

32.name: The Night Stalker (1972)
32.overview: Hardly a week goes by that, at the very least, one viewer will sadly admit that they miss the beloved series that aired weekly late night on our “Super Sci Fi Saturday Night” featuring the intrepid and somewhat rumbled reporter whose beat was the supernatural. There is reason to rejoice for all those fans who feel the same way-because tonight on MeTV- we have the origin story of that favorite reporter character who somehow always ends up pursuing the truth about something deadly from the realm of the unbelievable. It’s the made-for-TV movie that introduced us to Carl Kolchak, who’s out to convince authorities that they are dealing with a Vegas vampire- “The Night Stalker”!

32.name: Captain Kronos: Vampire Hunter (1974)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- get a look at a new hero walking in the footsteps of Dr. Van Helsing- that Hammer originally thought would begin a new series of adventures of “Captain Kronos- Vampire Hunter”!

32.name: Man Made Monster (1941)
32.overview: This Saturday night on MeTV- we’re bringing back a one-man dynamo, used as the prototype for a mindless electrical army. A carnival performer becomes a deadly menace in what is considered to be Lon Chaney Jr.’s very first entry into true horror films. See how a cruel and devious scientist uses Lon’s incredible tolerance for electrical current to transform him into the “Man-Made Monster”!

32.name: The Land Unknown (1957)
32.overview: This land is your land this land is … dino’s land?! Commander Alan Roberts is just your average US Navy commander taking his small helicopter crew on an exploratory mission into Antarctica to study oddly warm waters for the region. Pilot and geophysicist Lt. Jack Carmen is at the helm … or yoke … or whatever they use to fly a helicopter along with trusty machinist Steve Miller (the machinist one, not the musician one). Margaret Hathaway is the intrepid reporter along for the ride and hoping to get the story of her life. Ask and you shall receive Maragaret! Because your helicopter takes an unplanned trip to an unknown land right there in Antarctica that’s full of prehistoric dinosaurs, tropical plants, and a mad scientist named Hunter (not the Fred Dryer one) who hasn’t seen people in a really, really long time. Tonight, on MeTV - The Sven Squad are premiering 1957’s “The Land Unknown” on House of Svengoolie.

32.name: The Raven (1935)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV-we've brought back a 1930s classic that has not aired in a while- featuring Universal's two top horror stars of the era- as Bela Lugosi forces the hand of Boris Karloff to aid him in his horrible acts in "The Raven"!

32.name: Trilogy of Terror (1975)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we bring back a triple-play of terror in the legendary Dan Curtis production that stars Karen Black-playing the lead character in each segment of the anxiety-filled anthology that many have called the most frightening made-for-TV movie of all time- “Trilogy of Terror”! This 1975 film is a tour de frightening force, based on three stories by horror master Richard Matheson, with the final segment reaching true cult status for its overly effective effigy of a warrior!

32.name: They Came from Beyond Space (1967)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV-it’s beyond belief when alien forces take over human earthling hosts as slaves to help accomplish their secret mission- with only one man immune to their control who can battle their mission of conquest! Discover the truth behind why “They Came from Beyond Space”!

32.name: The Fly (1958)
32.overview: Tonight on MeTV- we bring back a landmark science fiction film of the 1950s- with “Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea” star David Hedison becoming the victim of his amazing scientific breakthrough- with Vincent Price trying to uncover the truth about “The Fly”!

32.name: The Ghost and Mr. Chicken (1966)
32.overview: Yes, it’s back again tonight on MeTV- and, for those of you asking, “why again?”- this is the horror/comedy that comes in, neck and neck, with “Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein” as perhaps the most requested movie our viewers demand to see. The man known for playing one of Mayberry’s best-known public servants plays the nervous hero who must endure a night in a house where a notorious murder took place and that is now labelled as haunted! Solving the mystery of the horrific event that took place requires him to stay there overnight– which could either land him his dream job as a newspaper reporter – and win him the lovely woman of his dreams- or land him in the middle of a real nightmare- caught between ghost troubles and legal woes. Don Knotts shivers his way through the 1966 classic- "The Ghost and Mr. Chicken"!

32.name: Night of the Living Dead (1990 )
32.overview: Hmmm, I feel like I’ve seen this movie somewhere before … That’s because tonight’s film is a remake of George Romero’s 1968 groundbreaking horror film “Night Of The Living Dead”! Barbara and her brother are just trying to visit their deceased mother’s grave when they discover … the undead! Barbara ends up seeking shelter in a farmhouse with gentle giant Ben, a well to do family of 3, a teenage couple, and more zombies than you can shake a pitchfork at. As the living attempt to fend off the dead, they discover what brings out the worst in both. Who will make it until sunrise when hopefully the authorities can arrive? Tune and find out tonight, on MeTV as The Sven Squad – Gwengoolie, Nostalgiaferatoo and IMP aka Ignatius Malvolio Prankenstein along with The Man In The Hat himself – Svengoolie – are premiering 1990’s “Night Of The Living Dead” on House of Svengoolie.

32.name: The Wizard of Oz (1939)
32.overview:
The Sven Squad and I travel somewhere over that rainbow for “The Wizard of Oz”

Do I really need to sum up the great 1939 classic story of a young girl who finds herself transported by a twister to a faraway land inhabited by little people, witches good and bad, and three loyal companions? We meet Dorothy Gale and her farm-hand friends, as well as her uncle and Auntie Em- but they have a run-in with the nasty Miss Gultch, who’s out to have Dorthy’s little dog Toto put away!

32.name: The Invisible Man Returns (1940)
32.overview: The Sven Squad takes a crack at a movie I’ve shown before- “The Invisible Man Returns”! Vincent Price is an innocent man framed for murder- who turns to the brother of Griffin, the original Invisible Man and begs him to make him invisible so he can escape and prove his innocence. This 1940 film costars Cedric Hardwicke as the evil head of a mining operation who has had a deadly hand in what has transpired.

32.name: Munster, Go Home! (1966)
32.overview: Our Halloween BOO-Nanza double feature this week brings us to England- once for an insane inheritance- and once for big top terror- as we go from that clown of a creature Herman Munster to murderous mayhem for ringmistress Joan Crawford- it’s “Munster Go Home” followed by “Berserk!”

32.name: Berserk (1967)
32.overview: Our Halloween BOO-Nanza double feature this week brings us to England- once for an insane inheritance- and once for big top terror- as we go from that clown of a creature Herman Munster to murderous mayhem for ringmistress Joan Crawford- it’s “Munster Go Home” followed by “Berserk!”

32.name: Invasion of the Body Snatchers (1956)
32.overview: Tonight’s "BOO-nanza" double feature involves alien take-overs in both movies- one through some perilous pods, and the other from large-forehead potential conquerors! It’s the thrilling combination of the original "Invasion of the Body Snatchers" and "This Island Earth"!

32.name: This Island Earth (1955)
32.overview: Right after that- the Sven Squad takes over with their take of a science fiction classic that I have previously shown- "This Island Earth"! This 1955 film begins with a strange green ray saving a disabled aircraft- and its pilot, atomic scientist Cal Meacham getting some electronic parts that are unbelievably advanced- and like nothing ever seen before! Then comes a mysterious set of plans to build a communication device- that picks up a message that Cal is requested to join an elite scientific group.

32.name: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark (1973)

overview: The host Svengoolie talks about various horror movies while showing the movies, one per episode, and gives an introduction to them and performs an act during the commercial breaks. One of the constant tropes is that he will ask a question, then cut back to the movie in a way that looks like the character is answering that question. He also does a deep dive on the early careers of the major actors, and also what has happened to them since then.
title: Svengoolie
